name: Sound Pass
description: Levels the interview voice in the active sequence the way Lee did in Assembly V1 (a Hard Limiter on every voice clip, top at -6 dB on the meters), but clip by clip so speech sits around -6 dB with the body between -12 and -6, even from clip to clip. Works on a safe copy; measured from Premiere's own render.

inputs.label: Voice tracks (optional)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. A1; empty = every clip playing a .wav (wireless) on an unmuted track

inputs.label: Ride quiet moments (Volume keyframes, up to +6 dB)

actions.label: Level interview audio
actions.confirm: Level the interview voice on a safe copy of this sequence? Each voice clip gets one Hard Limiter (Lee's V1 settings, ceiling -6 dB on the meters) with its own input boost, measured from Premiere renders of the voice tracks. With Ride quiet moments on, quiet phrases in the answers are lifted up to +6 dB with Volume keyframes. Only the TOOLKIT COPY changes; clip gain, Volume and faders are left as they are, and nothing is saved.
